summary: The maintained change-completeness predecessor has one literal inventory of the production CLI and eleven engine/edge test roots, checked against actual workflow command declarations. When engine or V2 compile subjects are affected it performs locked restores and Release builds before focused tests; failed restore/compiler prerequisites block all dependent tests and the expensive engine. Ordinary independent failures are retained within the existing bounds; missing tools, timeout, signals or unavailable coverage refuse success. Actual git impact uses no-renames so deleting a required linked source through an out-of-scope rename cannot hide its old path. V2 impact follows current project/reference and compiled-source metadata separately from engine_changed, preserving docs-only omission and existing expensive-workload selection. Affected projection and actual CLI suites reuse these current outputs with no-build/no-restore, real TRX and non-vacuity, collecting both independent results before aggregate failure. Native full edge tests and coherent qualification remain independent. The fixture uses closed fake tools for invocation/error/drift controls and an explicit static-only route; its default native zero-match Lifecycle control restores its own locked prerequisite so cold docs-only callers do not rely on earlier mixed-engine probes. Literal/all-inline/quoted-head workflow drift, actual Git rename and original-bug mutation, missing/failed/zero/malformed/skipped TRX and default prerequisite ordering are controlled. Fake-tool success is not compiler acceptance. Source fixes retain the original compile and compiled-fixture failures; no known-bad native predecessor execution or cold/warm timing is inferred. The main script bounds collection at 240 elapsed seconds; the fixture’s native commands use a 300-second elapsed deadline plus the existing kill grace, while its later static controls remain outside that deadline; the existing five-minute total job cap remains authoritative, with complete cold/warm feasibility still requiring hosted evidence. Source review/inert controls do not waive required checks, original coherent obligations or native resource/effect admission and establish no comparative savings.
title: Existing engine predecessor covers declared compiler roots and affected V2 callers
